items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s the first time I heard Charles Brackeen

ctx.x: At the Hillcrest. The first time I saw Ornette, he had long hair and was playing like Bird. He told everybody, when he developed his style, he was going to cut his hair. All of a sudden, a little time shorter, he cut his hair, and he was playing completely different. Don Cherry was there. Walter Benton used to be there all the time. Harold Land. The Hillcrest. That was the place to be. You’d walk in there, and boy, the music just never stopped. Elmo Hope was something. A lot of people never really got a chance to…
